Product.name: Cloudfoam Pure 2.0  Shoes
Product.description:
Step into these shoes for crisp, clean style and comfort. Thanks to their heritage adidas vibes, these running-inspired trainers make it easy to look calm, cool and collected. Whether you're hanging out with friends or trying not to get frazzled as you tick off your weekend to-do list, stay comfortable through it all. 

This product is made with Primegreen, a series of high-performance recycled materials.

review.author: Susi
review.name: The cushioning at the ball of the foot is nonexistent
review.reviewBody: The quality is fine but I prefer cushion for the whole foot not just the heel

review.author: TonyaC
review.name: Good for walking around
review.reviewBody: I work 12hr shifts on my feet throughout the day, and these shoes are nice haven't had any problems

review.author: JayW
review.name: Love them
review.reviewBody: These are super comfy and have great bounce to them. I have knee and back issues and they help release the pressure for both.

review.author: Taylor
review.name: I work in a hospital, I do a lot of walking. I broke my ankle and Fibula in 2020. I have tried different types of shoes ,and these are the ones
review.reviewBody: There comfortable,and stylish I will buy another pair in a different color

review.author: Allie22
review.name: Overall comfortable and functional
review.reviewBody: I’m normally a 7.5 but these are a bit snug so I would recommend sizing up a half size

review.author: Que
review.name: These are probably some of these worst shoes I’ve ever purchased. If I step on a pebble I would feel it. Not meant for walking or anything athletic.
review.reviewBody: These are light sure but maybe too light. There is hardly any support on the balls of your feet. If you want sneakers for walking around the house sure. But long walks, lifting, running all are a no with this shoe.

review.author: Patty
review.name: Best shoes ever
review.reviewBody: I'm 68 and best shoes. I have,tried other brands. Adidas the best.
